'''''Lampranthus multiradiatus''''', [[Synonym (taxonomy)|synonyms]] including '''''Lampranthus roseus''''',<ref name=POWO_362274-1/> known as the '''creeping redflush'''{{citation needed|date=January 2024}} or '''rosy dewplant''',<ref name=BSBI07>{{BSBI 2007 |accessdate=2024-01-06 }}</ref> is a species of shrub in the family [[Aizoaceae]] (stone plants). They are succulent plants with grey-green shoots. They have a self-supporting growth form and simple, broad leaves. The daisy type flowers have yellow centres and petals that vary between pink and purple depending on the season.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Lampranthus multiradiatus (Jacq.) N. E. Br. - Encyclopedia of Life|url=https://eol.org/pages/2942512|access-date=2022-02-04|website=eol.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Mifsud |first=Stephen |date=2002-08-23 |title=Lampranthus multiradiatus (Creeping Ice Plant) : MaltaWildPlants.com - the online Flora of the Maltese Islands. |url=https://www.maltawildplants.com/AIZO/Lampranthus_multiradiatus.php |access-date=2022-03-05 |website=www.maltawildplants.com |language=en-us}}</ref><ref>[http://www.shootgardening.co.uk/plant/lampranthus-roseus ''Lampranthus roseus''], Shootgardening, accessed January 2012</ref>
